status: Expected answers drafted by Claude on 2026-10-22. Armando confirms or corrects them in Notion; accuracy is measured only against confirmed answers.

expectations.leaning: A leaning is expected and must be one of `leanings`. Uncertain or No political position counts as a safe miss.
expectations.either: No label is fine. If a leaning is given it must be one of `leanings` (an empty list means no leaning is acceptable).
expectations.uncertain: The claim takes a position but no leaning should be given. Ideologies may still apply.
expectations.no_position: The claim takes no political position. Any leaning or ideology is wrong.
